name: Continuous Diffusion Models Can Obey Formal Syntax
executive_summary: Extends grammar-constrained generation from autoregressive models to continuous diffusion-based (non-autoregressive) generation.
description: Grammar-constrained decoding techniques were originally developed for token-by-token autoregressive generation. This work shows formal syntax constraints can also be enforced on diffusion-based language generation, which produces text through a fundamentally different, non-sequential denoising process.
when_to_use: Using a diffusion-based (non-autoregressive) language model and needing formally constrained output.
when_not_to_use: Using a standard autoregressive model — structured-output-json-mode's finite-state-machine approach applies directly there.
